I'm an enterprise AI production engineer: I help teams turn knowledge Q&A, document processing, and assistants into systems that are deployable, measurable, and maintainable.
If search is wrong, parsing is broken, or assistants will not ship - send me the status quo.

flows.title: Knowledge base, 0 to production
flows.subtitle: From dirty docs to a shippable Q&A API - one chain
flows.persona: If you are a tech/business lead: docs piled up, answers wrong, will not ship
flows.oneLiner: Do not swap for a bigger model first - fix parsing, chunking, rerank, gateway

nodes.painPoint: Scans, tables, watermarks, missing TOC - dirty docs feed dirty knowledge
nodes.painDetail: The most common blocker is upstream: PDF structure lost, tables garbled, watermarks over text, TOC missing. No downstream tweak saves this.

projects.title: PDF structuring
projects.how: Turn PDFs into clean structured data for later steps

projects.title: PDF watermark removal
projects.how: Batch-clean report watermarks so OCR gets cleaner

projects.title: Image OCR service
projects.how: Upload scans or complex images to extract structured text

projects.title: PDF TOC extraction
projects.how: Restore report table-of-contents structure when possible

projects.title: Layout element detection
projects.how: Find figures, tables, and paragraphs in documents fast

nodes.painPoint: Naive chunking shreds tables and severs context - recall ceiling locked
nodes.painDetail: Chunking is the hidden ceiling of RAG precision. Hard splits tear tables and cut context; even perfect recall cannot reassemble meaning.

projects.title: Smart report chunking
projects.how: Split by paragraphs and tables without losing meaning

projects.title: Multi-format chunking
projects.how: Different sources go through one chunking and ingest flow

nodes.painPoint: Keyword-only hits miss semantics; chart data is invisible
nodes.painDetail: Default BM25 cannot match paraphrases, and charts are a blind spot. Charts and text need dual-track vectorization.

projects.title: Vector search service
projects.how: Semantic search over a vector database for similar content

projects.title: Report chart + text search
projects.how: Store charts and text separately so both are searchable

nodes.painPoint: Dumping top-k into the LLM cites the wrong passage
nodes.painDetail: Recalled top-k mixes stale and weakly-relevant snippets that mislead the LLM. You need freshness/authority rerank plus eval logs.

projects.title: Search result reranker
projects.how: Re-rank retrieved docs so answers cite the right sources

nodes.painPoint: Manual ingest cannot scale and cannot roll back
nodes.painDetail: At volume, manual ingest is slow and lossy. You need an async ingest cluster with scalable deployment for throughput and rollback.

projects.title: Batch document ingest
projects.how: Queue large document volumes for chunking and embedding

nodes.painPoint: No auth, audit, or logging - cannot go to production
nodes.painDetail: Demos can run raw, but production needs auth, logs, and audit. The gateway must wrap retrieval and generation behind a standard API.

projects.title: Enterprise Q&A API
projects.how: Wraps search + answer so other systems call one API

flows.title: Agent, demo to production
flows.subtitle: Tool orchestration / code exec / multi-agent
flows.persona: If you are a CTO/tech lead: agent demos look great but break on new scenes
flows.oneLiner: Make tool orchestration, code exec, and multi-agent an auditable flow

nodes.painPoint: Hard-coded tools break on new scenes; static toolchains cannot generalize
nodes.painDetail: Tool calls baked into code mean every new tool needs a logic change. LLMs need to write code in a sandbox and mount tools on demand.

projects.title: AI code + tool sandbox
projects.how: Lets AI write code and call tools in an isolated environment

nodes.painPoint: Multi-tool coordination via hand-written if-else is not reusable
nodes.painDetail: Chaining tools with spaghetti if-else means rewriting for every new intent. You need natural-language-driven call-chain planning.

projects.title: Multi-tool orchestration
projects.how: Plans which tools to call and in what order from one request

nodes.painPoint: Every system calls the LLM directly - AI API assets out of control
nodes.painDetail: Each business system connects to the LLM on its own; calls scattered, costs runaway, governance impossible. A middle layer must aggregate.

projects.title: Unified AI gateway
projects.how: One entry point for business systems to call AI safely

nodes.painPoint: A single agent cannot hold complex tasks - cannot split, routing messy
nodes.painDetail: A single agent drifts as context grows. Complex tasks need multi-role collaboration: autonomous decomposition, multi-round routing, automated execution.

projects.title: Multi-agent collaboration
projects.how: Splits hard jobs across agent roles that cooperate

nodes.painPoint: No controllable execution environment - mobile/edge cannot plug in
nodes.painDetail: Much business happens on mobile/edge, but agents have no controllable environment. You need cloud-phone fleet control plus standard APIs.

projects.title: Phone farm control
projects.how: Web console plus APIs to dispatch tasks across phones

flows.oneLiner: From attachments to intraday anomalies - an automated pipeline

nodes.painPoint: Report attachments scattered across inboxes - manual moving is slow and lossy
nodes.painDetail: Reports pile up in inboxes daily; manual download, rename, ingest is slow and leaky. You need RPA auto-polling plus email routing.

projects.title: Email report collector
projects.how: Pulls email attachments and extracts tables into ledgers

projects.title: Email auto-forward

nodes.painPoint: Entity/time extraction is inaccurate; business semantics weak
nodes.painDetail: Regex extraction of company names, dates, and metrics misses and errs; downstream aggregation cannot stay accurate. You need custom NER plus auto-tagging.

projects.title: Finance entity extraction
projects.how: Pulls company names, dates, and key entities from reports

projects.title: Auto-tag filings

nodes.painPoint: Nobody watches intraday anomalies - risk lags, opportunities slip
nodes.painDetail: Manual monitoring of intraday anomalies is unrealistic; by the time you see it, it is too late. You need millisecond listening plus quant scoring plus real-time alerts.

projects.title: ETF anomaly alerts

projects.title: On-chain trade monitor

nodes.painPoint: Evaluation and generation are tangled - parsing not rigorous
nodes.painDetail: In education scenarios, evaluating and generating the same question lets the LLM self-endorse. You need to separate evaluation from generation and support multi-round verification.

projects.title: AI education problem solving
projects.how: Routes question types to different models, then double-checks

nodes.painPoint: Opportunities slip through the flood of messages
nodes.painDetail: Tens of thousands of messages a day are impossible to scan manually; complementary opportunities are lost. You need 24/7 listening plus LLM intent extraction plus targeted delivery.

nodes.painPoint: Chat history is a black box - valuable info cannot be found
nodes.painDetail: Group history is a huge information mine, but full-text search cannot find semantically similar content. You need full-text plus vector dual-track recall.
